"Information since March points to a strong labor market and solid growth, but with inflation running below the symmetric 2% objective and low market-based inflation compensation, the tone is cautiously positive. In New Keynesian policy frameworks (Clarida, Galí, and Gertler), anchored expectations with below-target inflation justify patience and a modest easing bias in guidance, while the technical adjustment to IOER to steer the funds rate within the target band (Goodfriend, 2002) does not itself change the policy stance. Overall, the communication is mildly upbeat on activity but tempered by muted inflation pressures."
